column2: 91.  (1)  The  President  may,  from  time  to  time,  issue
directions subject to the provisions of this Act, which shall
apply to police officers, members of armed forces and coast
guard officers pertaining to the manner in which the provisions
of this Act shall be enforced.
(2) The  directions  issued  under  subsection  (1),  shall  be
solely for the purpose of giving effect to the provisions of this
Act, in an efficacious manner and, be in compliance with the
human rights norms and standards recognized by law.
